gold: Cranial nerve 7 (CN7) paresis secondary to acute bacterial sinusitis

selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with purulent nasal secretions, polypoid changes of the right middle turbinate, and purulence within the nasal cavity, along with the CT scan findings of an orbital abscess extending from right-sided rhinosinusitis, strongly supports Rhinosinusitis as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings supporting this diagnosis

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus thrombosis
rejected.why: No evidence of thrombosis in the CT scan findings

rejected.label: Coagulase-negative Staphylococcus aureus infection
rejected.why: While the bacteria was cultured, the clinical presentation is more consistent with Rhinosinusitis
